lines.en: It's Saturday. The fridge is empty.
lines.zh: 今天是星期六，冰箱空了。

lines.en: I go out. I take a trolley.
lines.zh: 我出门去买东西，推了一辆推车。

lines.en: I see my neighbour and her son.
lines.zh: 我看到了邻居和她儿子。

lines.en: "Is he your son? He is very tall!"
He is a bit naughty.
"Don't worry. He is very cute."
I buy apples, bananas and tofu.
lines.zh: 我买了苹果、香蕉和豆腐。

lines.en: "Excuse me, do you have eggs?"
"Can I pay by card? I don't need a bag."
At night, I call my mum.
"Mum, I will cook tonight!"

dialogue.title: 陈太太打电话问女儿
dialogue.setting: 星期五下午，陈太太打电话到补习中心，想问问女儿上课的情况。

lines.speaker: Mrs Tan
lines.en: Hello, this is Mrs Tan.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Hello, Mrs Tan. How are you?

lines.speaker: Mrs Tan
lines.en: I'm fine. How is my daughter in class?
lines.zh: 我很好。我女儿上课怎么样？

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: She is very smart.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Her reading is getting better.

lines.speaker: Mrs Tan
lines.en: Good. Is she shy in class?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Yes, she is a bit shy.

lines.speaker: Mrs Tan
lines.en: Can I speak to her teacher?
lines.zh: 我可以和她的老师说话吗？

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Sorry, she is in class now.
lines.zh: 不好意思，她现在在上课。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: I will ask her to call you back.

lines.speaker: Mrs Tan
lines.en: Thank you. I worry about her.

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Don't worry. Let's work together.

lines.speaker: Mrs Tan
lines.en: Thank you very much. Bye!

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Thank you for calling. Bye!
